# Economy

An economy bot using Robo.js with currency, shops, and transactions.

<Cards>
  <Card href="/docs/discord-bots" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
  <Card href="/docs/framework/core/flashcore" title="Flashcore" description="Persist data in your Robo." />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-bots/economy-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- Virtual currency system
- Balance management
- Transactions between users
- Shop functionality
- Leaderboards

## Commands

- `/balance` - Check your balance
- `/daily` - Claim daily rewards
- `/pay` - Transfer currency to another user
- `/shop` - Browse and buy items
- `/leaderboard` - See top users

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
